runnerReason: default; scenario needs no real Pods, DRA, TAS node-fit, or MultiKueue
scenarioYaml:
# Admitted Workload WITHOUT a WorkloadPriorityClass gets a negative
# priority boost while another Workload waits. With PriorityBoost on, the
# boost must re-evaluate pending work: the admitted one is preempted and the
# pending one reserves quota. Derived from kueue#17991.
name: priority-boost-no-wpc
description: >-
  PriorityBoost on a Workload without WorkloadPriorityClass re-evaluates
  pending Workloads (preempts the boosted-down admitted one).
test: "test/integration/singlecluster/scheduler/scheduler_test.go: when PriorityBoost is enabled, boosting an admitted Workload without a WorkloadPriorityClass, re-evaluates pending Workloads"
featureGates:
  PriorityBoost: true
namespaces: [pr-evidence]
timeout: 10s
steps:
  - apply: |
      apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta2
      kind: ResourceFlavor
      metadata: {name: on-demand}
      ---
      apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta2
      kind: ClusterQueue
      metadata: {name: preemption-cq}
      spec:
        namespaceSelector: {}
        resourceGroups:
        - coveredResources: [cpu]
          flavors:
          - name: on-demand
            resources:
            - {name: cpu, nominalQuota: "3"}
        preemption:
          withinClusterQueue: LowerPriority
      ---
      apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta2
      kind: LocalQueue
      metadata: {name: preemption-queue}
      spec: {clusterQueue: preemption-cq}
  - waitFor: {kind: ClusterQueue, name: preemption-cq, condition: Active, status: "True"}
  - apply: &wl
      apiVersion: kueue.x-k8s.io/v1beta2
      kind: Workload
      metadata: {name: wl-admitted}
      spec:
        queueName: preemption-queue
        priority: 0
        podSets:
        - name: main
          count: 1
          template:
            spec:
              restartPolicy: Never
              containers:
              - name: c
                image: registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10
                resources: {requests: {cpu: "2"}}
  - waitFor: {kind: Workload, name: wl-admitted, condition: Admitted, status: "True"}
  - capture: admitted
  - apply:
      <<: *wl
      metadata: {name: wl-pending}
  - waitFor: {kind: Workload, name: wl-pending, condition: QuotaReserved, status: "False"}
  - waitFor: {kind: ClusterQueue, name: preemption-cq, field: status.pendingWorkloads, equals: 1}
  - capture: second-pending
  - patch:
      kind: Workload
      name: wl-admitted
      merge: {metadata: {annotations: {kueue.x-k8s.io/priority-boost: "-100"}}}
  - waitFor: {kind: Workload, name: wl-admitted, condition: Evicted, status: "True", reason: Preempted}
  - capture: boosted-preempted
  - finishEviction: {name: wl-admitted}
  - waitFor: {kind: Workload, name: wl-pending, condition: QuotaReserved, status: "True"}
  - capture: pending-reserved
